note: Week 8 (stats through Nov 18): the weekly picker's story, with a hand-written script because the reel step isn't in the workflow yet.

beats.text: Biggest jump in our Hart model this week.
Kirill Kaprizov was No. 15 last week. Now he's No. 3. That's twelve spots in one week.
Here's what jumped out to me. Forty points in 23 games, 17 goals, a plus-21, and the Wild are 16-3-4.
Connor McDavid still sits at No. 1, with 55 points.
Want to see the rest? Full board at stingercollectibles.com
